noticias.titular: 2026 MLB wild-card series Day 2: Live updates, lineups, analysis
noticias.texto: Which teams will sweep and which will force a Game 3? We've got it all covered for you.

noticias.titular: Padres' Salas set to become youngest ever to catch playoff game
noticias.texto: Ethan Salas will be the Padres' starting catcher and bat seventh in the lineup in Wednesday night's Game 2 against the Cubs, making him the youngest in MLB history to catch in a postseason game.

noticias.titular: 2026 MLB playoffs: Schedule, postseason bracket, standings
noticias.texto: We have your one-stop shop for everything you need to keep up with all the action this October.

noticias.titular: Red Sox's Roman Anthony ruled out of ALWC with hand, wrist injuries
noticias.texto: Red Sox outfielder Roman Anthony has been ruled out of the AL Wild Card Series and the foreseeable future after damaging muscles in his wrist during Game 1, Red Sox manager Chad Tracy said Wednesday.

noticias.titular: MLB wild-card round odds: The favorites for every series
noticias.texto: The wild-card round schedule, lines and odds to win.

noticias.titular: Red Sox OF Anthony (hand) exits early; Game 2 status unclear
noticias.texto: It's unclear whether Red Sox OF Roman Anthony will be available for Game 2 of their AL Wild Card Series after suffering an injury to the same hand that sidelined him for nearly four months.

noticias.titular: Padres pummel Cubs behind Tatis' leadoff blast, King's gem in Game 1
noticias.texto: The Padres made an emphatic statement in their wild-card opener against the Cubs, getting a leadoff homer from Fernando Tatis Jr. and a brilliant effort on the mound from Michael King in an 8-0 win in Game 1.

noticias.titular: 2026 MLB wild-card series Day 1: Takeaways, analysis
noticias.texto: Relive the action from a jam-packed opener of wild-card games.

noticias.titular: Schlittler, Rice lead Yankees' rout of Red Sox in Game 1
noticias.texto: Cam Schlittler pitched another playoff gem against the Red Sox and Ben Rice also burned their hometown team with a late grand slam and six RBIs as the Yankees opened this AL Wild Card Series rematch with a 9-0 victory.

noticias.titular: Padres add Joe Musgrove, out since 2024, to wild-card roster
noticias.texto: RHP Joe Musgrove last played in 2024 before undergoing Tommy John surgery, but the Padres added him to their wild-card roster Tuesday.

noticias.titular: Red Sox add Garrett Crochet to wild-card roster vs. Yankees
noticias.texto: Red Sox left-hander Garrett Crochet, who has not pitched since April because of shoulder inflammation, will be available out of the bullpen vs. the Yankees.

noticias.titular: Aaron Judge won't play ALWCS; Giancarlo Stanton makes roster
noticias.texto: Aaron Judge will not play for the Yankees in the AL Wild Card series, but Giancarlo Stanton -- who hasn't played in over five months -- was included on the roster.
